## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Testing

Describe how you tested the change (commands run, backend used, manual steps).

## Checklist

- [ ] The PR title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/), for example `feat(todos): add due date` or `fix: handle an empty title`.
- [ ] `bun run lint` passes.
- [ ] `bun run format:check` passes (run `bun run format` to fix).
- [ ] `bun run check` passes.
- [ ] `bun test` passes.
- [ ] `bun run build` passes.
- [ ] `bun run test:e2e` passes, if the change affects routes, UI, or the database adapters.
- [ ] Documentation is updated if behavior or setup changed.
- [ ] No secrets or environment values are included; `.env` is not committed.
- [ ] The change is focused and ready for review.
